family.tagline: A garden room for clients, a football rota on the Core.
family.story: Thandi is a counselor who sees clients in the Garden Room. Nils coaches a youth five-a-side team. The appointment times and the weekend rota share one Core.

companion.name: Nomsa
companion.job: Drafts appointment reminders for Thandi to send. Times only.
companion.limits: Times only. Thandi sends every message.

companion.name: Tully
companion.job: Opens Vikunja in its own browser and lines up the weekend team rota.
companion.limits: Lines up a rota. Nils confirms with parents.

popup.title: Home from practice, a parcel
popup.body: Nils comes home from practice and finds a parcel at the front door. He carries it a few steps to the shelf in the Hearth Salon.

popup.title: Everything in the parcel
popup.body: Thandi unpacks the parcel: the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. The footprint is about three quarters of a sheet of paper.

popup.title: Plug it in, start the clock
popup.body: Nils plugs in the cable and presses the button, like a referee starting the clock. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Thandi joins from her phone
popup.body: Thandi joins the Core's own network from her phone. Then she picks the home network.

popup.title: Pick your first agents and apps
popup.body: In Companion Hub, Thandi picks Hermes and Nils picks OpenClaw. They add Baikal, Vikunja and Immich, then walk away.

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Nomsa says hello
popup.body: Thandi messages the agent she named Nomsa. Nomsa answers, and the Core is running.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: thandi
say.text: Hello, Thandi. Nomsa here. Shall we begin?

beats.capability: stream your own movies, shows and music to every screen in the house

popup.title: Film night, from their own library
popup.body: On Friday, Thandi and Nils pick a film from their own library in Jellyfin. It streams from the Core to the TV.

beats.capability: back up, search and organise your family photos and videos on your own Core

popup.title: The season's album, kept at home
popup.body: Nils sorts the season's match-day photos into an Immich album from the couch. The album stays on the Core.

beats.capability: read ebooks in your browser, with notes, highlights and text-to-speech

popup.title: A book by the fire
popup.body: By the fire, Thandi reads in Koodo Reader. Her notes and highlights stay in the library on the Core.

beats.capability: a shared grocery list, recipe book, meal planner and expense tracker for the household

popup.title: Dinners, plus oranges for the match
popup.body: Thandi keeps the week's dinners in KitchenOwl at the breakfast bar. Nils adds the oranges for Saturday's match from his phone.

beats.capability: split shared costs with housemates, family or friends and settle up with the fewest payments

popup.title: Who owes what for the balls
popup.body: Nils splits the cost of new match balls among the parents with Spliit. It shows who owes whom, and no money moves.

beats.capability: a small CalDAV and CardDAV server for your calendars and contacts

popup.title: Appointment times, nothing else
popup.body: Thandi keeps her appointment times in Baikal. The calendar holds times only, and it sits on the Core.

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Nomsa drafts the day's reminders
popup.body: Thandi asks Nomsa for tomorrow's reminders. Nomsa drafts one per appointment, with the time only. Thandi reads each and sends it herself.

say.speaker: thandi
say.text: Drafts ready. Times only. Please check each one.

beats.capability: send invoices and quotes, track expenses and time

popup.title: Invoices written at the desk
popup.body: At month end Thandi writes the practice invoices in Invoice Ninja at her desk. Every invoice stays on the Core.

beats.capability: write a wiki or a set of manuals in books, chapters and pages, with search and history

popup.title: The practice handbook, written down
popup.body: Thandi writes the practice handbook in BookStack: opening hours, room rules and the supplier list.

beats.capability: store every password in a vault you host; works with the Bitwarden apps

popup.title: Practice logins, kept in a vault
popup.body: Thandi keeps the practice logins in VaultWarden. It works with the Bitwarden apps, and the vault lives on the Core.

beats.capability: lists, boards and calendars for tasks, with reminders and recurring jobs

popup.title: Tully lines up the weekend rota
popup.body: Nils reads out the weekend's pitch slots. Tully opens Vikunja in its own browser and lines up the rota. Nils confirms with the parents himself.

say.speaker: nils
say.text: Rota lined up. Please check the slots.

beats.capability: a small CalDAV and CardDAV server for your calendars and contacts

popup.title: The parents' numbers stay put
popup.body: Nils keeps the parents' phone numbers in Baikal's contact list. They sit on the Core, and his phone reads the same list.

beats.capability: a whiteboard with a hand-drawn look; sketch ideas together

popup.title: Corner routines on a whiteboard
popup.body: Nils sketches Saturday's corner routine on an Excalidraw whiteboard. The hand-drawn arrows are saved on the Core.

beats.capability: listen to your audiobooks and podcasts, and pick up where you left off on any device

popup.title: A coaching podcast, picked up
popup.body: In bed, Nils plays a coaching podcast in Audiobookshelf. It remembers where he stopped, so tomorrow starts in the same place.

beats.capability: track your plants, watering and care history across rooms and beds, with photos and a garden journal

popup.title: The planters get a journal
popup.body: Thandi logs the deck planters in HortusFox: what grows where, when she watered it, and a photo for the journal.

beats.capability: control and automate your smart home from one place, locally

popup.title: Deck lights, set for dusk
popup.body: Nils sets the deck and cabana lights to come on at dusk in Home Assistant. It runs on the Core and reaches them over the home Wi-Fi.

popup.title: Two working lives, one Core
popup.body: A counselor and a coach, a garden room and a pitch. The Mahlangu-Engstrom household runs on one Companion Core.

closing.body: Your appointment times, your team rota and your family photos can live on a Companion Core at home. Start with one calendar in Baikal.

notes: Owner sign-off open: the FTUE hotspot flow is written as the owner specified and is not on the fact sheet (STORY-BIBLE section 15, item 1).

Care note kept: counseling is named as work only. No clinical, confidentiality or compliance wording; the privacy story is the times-only calendar, the reminders and the parents' contact list. Please re-read room-calendar.

No garden zone of ten square meters: the garden chapter is the deck planters and deck lights, and the text says "the deck" and "the planters". Music Assistant would suit the deck but the validator bans the word assistant.

salon-tv uses Jellyfin on the Hearth Salon TV (the home has a wall TV); Jellyfin plays the family's own library only. deck-lights is the Home Assistant iot beat: a schedule over the home Wi-Fi, no energy figure, no USB or Bluetooth device.
table-rota: the agent prepares the rota and Nils confirms with the parents himself, outside the Core. No parent is shown using an app. table-contacts claims nothing about the parents' devices.
kitchen-balls: Spliit shows who owes whom and moves no money (catalog caveat). Football means association football; five-a-side is named in the story and the pitch is the walled plaza in the render.
Voice-over lexicon: Mahlangu, Engstrom, Thandi, Nils, Nomsa, Tully, Protea Vale, Fynbos, Jellyfin, Spliit, Baikal, Vikunja, BookStack, VaultWarden, Excalidraw, Audiobookshelf, HortusFox.
Street Fynbos Close and town Protea Vale are invented; the human map check is still open (fynbos and protea are plant words, check the pair is not a real address).
